name: derm
description: derm's own plugins, installed from a clone of this repository: claude plugin marketplace add /abs/path/derm, then claude plugin install derm@derm. Added by integration w1 so the plugin id is derm@derm, as packages/derm-claude-plugin/managed-settings.fragment.json expects.

plugins.name: derm
